name: Healthchecks.io Status Check (Cronsole)
description: Read a Healthchecks.io status badge and fail the run unless every check behind it is up — a second, independent reader for a cron fleet that runs somewhere else, so a silent outage shows up in Cronsole instead of waiting on an alert email.

parameters.label: Badge JSON URL
parameters.help: From Healthchecks.io › Badges, the JSON format — e.g. https://healthchecks.io/badge/<key>/<tag>.json. A tag badge covers every check with that tag; "*" covers the whole project. A check that is late (grace) fails this too.
